decisions.reason: The source's separate outreach-selection instruction is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the lead spreadsheet inclusion criterion does not further change outreach behavior.
Restricting spreadsheet entry to hosts willing to proceed with content does not change how interested-host conversations are advanced or scheduled.
The revised Airbnb lead-recording criterion does not change assignment counts, deadlines, or completion expectations.
The candidate concerns ecommerce product records and is unrelated to criteria for recording interested Airbnb hosts.
Although the message directs immediate outreach, its lead inclusion criterion does not change the existing general initiative and independent-execution policy.
The Airbnb lead-tracking change has no effect on Shopify product publication requirements.
The instruction not to read Airbnb reviews applies to host outreach and does not alter CJ Dropshipping product research criteria.
References to moving forward with content describe Airbnb host interest and do not modify the Google Content Bank artifact or its use.
The Airbnb spreadsheet inclusion rule does not affect how ClickUp subtasks or goal parent tasks are marked.
The source decision concerns Airbnb lead tracking and does not change TikTok Shop product listing behavior.
The source decision has no semantic relationship to visibility of shared credentials in Bitwarden.
Entering qualified Airbnb leads into their spreadsheet does not change the general rule for storing task artifacts in linked Google documents.
